subject: Closing playbook: ramp sprint & TPM schedule
messages:
From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam@edgepay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Closing playbook: ramp sprint & TPM schedule

Liam —

Thanks for the demo last week. Per our conversation, attached is a first-pass closing playbook (redwood_closing_playbook_v1.xlsx) that ties evaluation milestones to a ramped TPM commitment and pricing breakpoints. High level:

- Pilot / Eval (30 days): up to 25M tokens, no commit, goal = latency & quality gate reviews.
- Sprint 1 (month 1 post-sign): 80M TPM target (baseline billing)
- Sprint 2 (month 2): 180M TPM target (trigger 5% discount on base rate)
- Sprint 3 (month 3+): 350M TPM target (trigger 12% volume discount + prepay credit option)

We put conservative inter-month ramp factors to protect your spend during warm-up while giving you clear breakpoints for discounts. Pricing details are summarized in pricing_terms_v3.pdf (attached).

Ask: can you confirm the internal stakeholders who will sign off on the 30-day eval results and whether procurement needs additional redlines? If EdgePay is comfortable with the Sprint breakpoints above we can bake them into the MAP and lock a target close date for April 30th.

Next steps I propose this week:
- You confirm procurement contact and any required PO language (procure@edgepay.com?)
- We finalize MAP milestones and sign-off owners (I can update the XLSX)
- Marissa will share final commercial confirmation and contract draft for legal review

Thanks — I left a few in-line comments in the spreadsheet around data retention & logging cadence.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0137

Attachments: redwood_closing_playbook_v1.xlsx, pricing_terms_v3.pdf

From: Liam O'Neill <liam@edgepay.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@edgepay.com
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 11:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Closing playbook: ramp sprint & TPM schedule

Kim —

Appreciate the clear layout. A couple things from our side:

- Procurement loop: yes, that's the right address (procure@edgepay.com) — they'll need typical SOW / prepay language.
- Ramp ask: our ops team prefers a slower initial ramp. Would you consider an alternate path: Month1 = 40M, Month2 = 120M, Month3 = 260M? That reduces early risk while still landing us at meaningful volume by month 3.
- Discounts: the 12% at 350M looks fair, but can we introduce a 7% accelerator at 250M so we get some upside if usage outperforms the base path?

We can still meet the April 30th intent to close but need to confirm legal timing — procurement said 7–10 business days after commercial terms.

I'll review the XLSX and push the procurement team to get you a list of sign-off names today.

Regards,
Liam O'Neill
Head of Platform Engineering | EdgePay
liam@edgepay.com

Subject: Re: Closing playbook: ramp sprint & TPM schedule

Liam —

Thanks for the quick feedback. Happy to flex on initial ramp — we can accept your proposed path (40M / 120M / 260M) as the default MAP ladder with the following commercial adjustments:

- Add a 7% accelerator at 250M TPM (retroactive to the month where threshold is achieved).
- Keep 12% at 350M as the top-tier volume discount.
- Introduce a usage credit: if EdgePay exceeds 380M in any month within the first 6 months, Redwood will issue a one-time onboarding credit equal to 3% of that month's bill.

Contract notes:
- We will include a 30-day eval clause with objective QA gates (latency < 120ms p95, prompt accuracy—sample pass rate > 92%).
- Billing terms: monthly invoicing with net-30. Prepay option available for additional 2% discount on committed spend.

Legal timing: Marissa to share contract redline template today and will coordinate with legal to target a 7 business day review window once commercial terms are agreed.

Action items:
- Liam: confirm procurement signers and PO language (procure@edgepay.com)
- Kimberly: update MAP spreadsheet with agreed ramp and accelerator
- Ben: confirm onboarding SLOs and CS milestones for pilot (see onboarding checklist)

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: pricing_terms_v3.pdf
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4821

Thanks — I updated the spreadsheet with the agreed ramp (40M / 120M / 260M) and added a 250M accelerator row that applies retroactively the month the threshold is hit. I also attached a one-page MAP summary to the SharePoint link (private).

Inline summary (for record):
- Eval: 0–25M (30 days) — QA gates listed in sheet
- Month1: 40M TPM — baseline rate; no discount
- Month2: 120M TPM — 5% discount applied to overage above baseline
- Month3: 260M TPM — 7% accelerator at 250M retro; 12% top tier at 350M
- Billing: monthly, net-30; prepay = additional 2% off committed spend

I've also called out the acceptance owners in the sheet: Liam (Platform Eng) for QA gates, Sophie P. from EdgePay procurement (procure@edgepay.com) for contract/PO.

Can Ben confirm CS kickoff dates and the pilot success metric owner so we can lock the Sprint 1 start date? We are targeting a signed date of 2026-04-30 which would put Sprint 1 start week of 2026-05-03.

Thanks,
Kim
